## 海军与印太 · 7 items

The Indo-Pacific naval landscape is active: the U.S. Navy sank a decommissioned amphib in Valiant Shield drills, Japan commissioned its 10th Mogami-class frigate, and Poland ordered three A26 submarines from Saab. The legendary wreck-hunter RV Petrel has been reborn as a U.S. Navy survey ship. Meanwhile, a Marine went missing from USS Anchorage.

- **Valiant Shield SINKEX**: Ex-USS Juneau (LPD-10) was sunk in the Philippine Sea during coordinated air-surface-subsurface strikes, validating long-range maritime strike concepts ([USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/29/former-u-s-amphib-sunk-in-pacific-maritime-strike-drills)).
- **Japan’s Frigate**: JMSDF commissioned JS Nagara (FFM-10), part of a 10-ship Mogami-class build focused on leaner, more technologically advanced surface warfare ([Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/06/japan-commissions-10th-mogami-class-frigate-nagara-%e3%80%8c%e3%81%aa%e3%81%8c%e3%82%89%e3%80%8d/)).
- **European Naval Buildup**: Poland signed a SEK 47 billion contract for three A26 submarines; the UK announced at least six Common Combat Vessels to replace Type 45 destroyers, sustaining shipyards for decades ([Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/06/saab-receives-order-for-three-a26-submarines-for-poland/), [Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/06/at-least-six-common-combat-vessels-will-be-built-for-the-royal-navy/)).
- **U.S. Fleet Tracker**: 101 Navy and USNS ships underway, with the USS George Washington carrier strike group conducting SINKEX in the Philippine Sea ([USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/29/usni-news-fleet-and-marine-tracker-june-29-2026)).
- **Personnel Incident**: A Marine lost at sea from USS Anchorage off California; investigation ongoing ([USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/29/marine-missing-from-uss-anchorage-declared-lost-at-sea)).

**Signal:** The pace of naval modernization and live-fire drills in the Pacific indicates a deliberate U.S. and allied push to demonstrate sea-denial capabilities, while European navies are simultaneously recapitalizing for high-end conflict.
